subject: EAL
body: On a road where traffic keeps left, you normally overtake
explanation: Overtaking on the left is only allowed in special cases, such as when the vehicle ahead is turning right.

subject: EAL
body: At a roundabout where traffic keeps left, you should
options: give way to traffic coming from your right and go round clockwise
give way to traffic from your left

subject: EAL
body: On a multi-lane road where traffic keeps left, slower vehicles should use
explanation: The right lane is for overtaking.

subject: EAL
body: When turning right at a junction, you should position your vehicle
options: on the wrong side of the road
in the middle of the junction
just left of the centre line
explanation: Give way to oncoming traffic first.

subject: EAL
body: When turning left, you should keep
options: to the right of the centre line
close to the left-hand side of the road
explanation: Watch for cyclists and pedestrians on your left.

subject: EAL
body: Before turning right, you should check
options: nothing if the road is quiet
your mirrors and the right-hand blind spot, and signal

subject: EAL
body: When an emergency vehicle with siren and flashing lights approaches, you should
options: stop in the middle of the road
pull over to the left and let it pass

subject: EAL
body: When parking at night on a road where traffic keeps left, you should park
options: on the right facing oncoming traffic
in the middle of the road
on the left, facing the direction of traffic
explanation: Use parking lights if the road is unlit.

subject: EAL
body: When you are being overtaken, you should
options: keep to the left and not speed up
explanation: Help the other driver pass safely.

subject: EAL
body: A motorcyclist in a country where traffic keeps left should ride
options: on the left side of the lane they are using, but not too close to the edge
explanation: Stay visible to other road users.

subject: EAL
body: At a junction with no signs or markings, you should
options: slow down, look both ways and give way to traffic already on the road
always expect others to give way
